subject: ConsultEx - GCP Private Offer: entitlements, sandbox & billing topology
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@consultex.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: James Hunt <james.hunt@consultex.com>, GCP Partner AM <gcp-am@google.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ConsultEx - GCP Private Offer: entitlements, sandbox & billing topology

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. As discussed, we're ready to progress the GCP Private Offer for our joint solution but we need to lock down three things before legal/finance greenlights the PO:

1) Entitlement model and sell-with/resale options (we need a clear mapping for reseller vs direct billing).
2) Demo/sandbox topology for our engineering partner team — we want a reproducible runbook so our pre-sales can demo without touching production keys.
3) Billing topology and metering (how usage will be reported to GCP and how Redwood will surface metered SKUs in the Private Offer).

I've attached a quick spreadsheet that outlines our preferred entitlement tiers and asked our partner AM at GCP to join the thread for any marketplace-specific constraints. Can you confirm who at Redwood will own the entitlement mapping and whether you can provide a sandbox runbook (network diagram, service accounts, sample IAM roles)?

Attachments: consultex_private_offer_map.xlsx (XLSX)

Best,
Maria Lopez
Head of Partnerships, ConsultEx
m: +1 415-555-0198

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@consultex.com>
Cc: James Hunt <james.hunt@consultex.com>, GCP Partner AM <gcp-am@google.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ConsultEx - GCP Private Offer: entitlements, sandbox & billing topology

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet.

High-level responses and owners:

- Entitlements / sell-with mapping: Ben Carter (cc'd) will lead the entitlement SKU mapping and coordinate with our billing team. We will align sell-with vs reseller on the SKU matrix and produce a mapping spreadsheet compatible with GCP Private Offer fields.

- Sandbox / demo runbook: I can own the runbook delivery end-to-end. We'll provide a runbook + Terraform snippets that create an isolated demo topology (private keys, service account with limited scopes, KV/cache mock). Ben will validate what we surface as SKUs in the demo.

- Billing & metering: Vivek Kulkarni (copied below) is our marketplace lead for billing integrations; he will confirm metering signals and how usage reports are emitted to GCP.

Action items from Redwood:
- Ben: draft entitlement SKU mapping (due 2026-07-07).
- Vivek: confirm metering feed and reporting format (due 2026-07-09).
- Jasmine: produce demo-sandbox-runbook.md and a short network diagram (due 2026-07-14).

Can we lock a 45-min joint session next week (July 7 or 8) to walk the spreadsheet and agree the minimal set of entitlements for the initial PO? I'll send calendar invites once Ben confirms availability.

Quick note on evidence: our security team will ask for SOC2 artifacts for the Private Offer review — I've asked Olga Petrov on the infra team to prepare a stub set of evidence we can share under NDA.

Attachments referenced: consultex_private_offer_map.xlsx (from your email)

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Partner Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: ConsultEx - GCP Private Offer: entitlements, sandbox & billing topology

Folks — looping in more detailed technical context after reviewing Maria's spreadsheet. Below are my notes; I pasted the salient rows from ConsultEx map into the Drive folder (link below).

Summary notes:
- Entitlement tiers: ConsultEx requests three tiers (trial, team, enterprise). We should map those to SKU families: sandbox-trial (non-billable), compute-hour (metered), feature-pack-1 (flat monthly). For sell-with, we'll offer an "agent" SKU that GCP can resell.

- Metering: GCP Private Offer requires a usage report (CSV/JSON) using granularity per resource id. We already emit per-tenant token_count and GPU_seconds; Vivek, is token_count acceptable, or do we need per-request IDs?

- Sandbox topology: recommend a shared sandbox project per partner with ephemeral service accounts scoped to demo VMs + a mock KV (no customer data). I attached a lightweight runbook (demo-sandbox-runbook.md) and the initial entitlement mapping workbook (consultex_private_offer_map.xlsx).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExAMPLEdriveLink
Attachments: consultex_private_offer_map.xlsx (updated v2), demo-sandbox-runbook.md

Next steps (technical):
1) Vivek: confirm the usage signal fields GCP expects and whether we must include externally-visible SKU codes (due 2026-07-09).
2) Olga: can you stage the SOC2 evidence placeholder (redacted) to the Drive folder for ConsultEx's security review? We should avoid sending full documents until NDA is in place.
3) Jasmine/Ben: run the joint session with GCP AM and ConsultEx (target 2026-07-14).

Hi Maria and team — following our alignment call this morning, quick recap and agreed plan. Quoted the call notes below for context.

Agreements from 7/14 session:
- Entitlement mapping: We agreed on three SKUs (sandbox-trial, compute-hour, enterprise-flat). Ben will publish the SKU codes and the mapping spreadsheet to the Drive folder by EOD 7/16.
- Metering feed: GCP will consume a daily usage report (CSV) with fields: date, tenant_id, sku_code, usage_amount, usage_unit. Vivek confirmed token_count and gpu_seconds are valid usage units. We will provide a sample CSV schema.
- Sandbox topology & runbook: Attached runbook (demo-sandbox-runbook.md) — includes Terraform snippets, network diagram, and a short checklist for pre-sales. ConsultEx agreed to use the sandbox project and create ephemeral demo accounts.
- Security evidence: Olga uploaded a redacted SOC2 evidence packet (soc2-evidence_stub.pdf) to the Drive folder under a restricted view for ConsultEx. Full evidence will be provided after NDA executed.

Open items / next actions:
- Ben: SKU codes + entitlement mapping published to Drive (due 2026-07-16).
- Vivek: sample daily usage CSV schema + example (due 2026-07-16).
- ConsultEx (Maria): confirm internal procurement timeline and whether they prefer a Private Offer or a Managed Resale structure (target reply 2026-07-20).
- Jasmine: draft a short mutual action plan and send a DocuSign engagement statement for signatures (I'll share by 7/16).

Attachments: demo-sandbox-runbook.md (MD), consultex_private_offer_map.xlsx (XLSX v2), soc2-evidence_stub.pdf (PDF, redacted)
